sentences.text: The documents do not state the monthly EMI for INR 650,000 at 11.5% per year over 60 months.
The documents state EMI is the equated monthly instalment and state an EMI amount of ₹21,696 in the home loan agreement and the Key Facts Statement, but not for this loan amount, rate, and term.
